title: VIXEN GPU schema staging omits SaveHistory lineage sidecars
body: The Release target frame_targets_schema_check ran CodegenTool --schema-json-source against build/wsl/codegen/gpu-schema-source and failed because SaveHistory/lineage.json was absent, even though the paired Undertow source contains core/src/Undertow.Sim/SaveHistory/lineage.json and Undertow.Substrate/SaveHistory/lineage.json. StageGpuSchemaSource.cmake only globs and copies *.cs, so the lane had to diagnose and exclude the unrelated all-target gate while the recipe targets passed. Stage declared JSON sidecars or derive the schema-source manifest from all generator inputs.

title: VIXEN codegen materializer loses the output-directory separator
body: The first full Release VIXEN configure/build failed before recipe compilation because the generated codegen CMake command passed --output <build>/codegen/tool/bin and CodegenTool concatenated its filename directly, attempting <build>/binSDFNodeGenerator.dll. Recovery patched the ignored generated build/wsl/codegen/tool-build.cmake directory argument to end with '/'; the consumer should normalize directory outputs or use a path join at the generator boundary.
